headline: AutoDNA: Inside China's First 100% AI-Run Science Lab Where Humans Empty Trash
author: Intellectual Hive Hindi
text:
AutoDNA: Inside China's First 100% AI-Run Science Lab Where Humans Empty Trash

Imagine studying thick science books for years — only to be called into the lab to empty the trash bin!

In November 2026, researchers at Shanghai Jiao Tong University published an official report in the world's top science journal Nature unveiling AutoDNA — the world's first AI-native biomolecular science laboratory where 6 AI Agents run 20+ hi-tech lab machines and robotic arms completely on their own.

Just type one line in simple English:
- 1st AI Agent reads scientific research papers
- 2nd AI Agent plans the full experiment
- 3rd AI Agent writes Python code
- 4th AI Agent controls robotic arms & lab hardware

During heating tests, the AI even realized on its own that liquid in test tubes could evaporate — and automatically commanded the robotic arm to cap every tube without human instruction!

To test its limits, scientists challenged AutoDNA to store Stephen Hawking's famous quote — "Intelligence is the ability to adapt to change." — inside real DNA like a pendrive. Working 203 hours non-stop (over 8 days without a break), the AI completed 11,000+ steps, synthesized 78 DNA strands, stored them in the fridge, read the exact quote back with zero errors, and even caught a hidden cancer mutation! Humans were only pinged when plastic tips ran out and the lab dustbin got full.
